faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DLSA Prakasam Para Legal Volunteer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for DLSA Prakasam Para Legal Volunteer Recruitment 2026 is 30 September 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the eligibility criteria for Para Legal Volunteer posts?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Para Legal Volunteer post must have passed Intermediate (10+2). Further details regarding eligibility can be found in the official notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for Para Legal Volunteer in DLSA Prakasam?
faq.answer: Selected Para Legal Volunteers will receive an honorarium as decided by the District Legal Services Authority, Prakasam District, Ongole. Specific details are available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection process for DLSA Prakasam Para Legal Volunteer?
faq.answer: The selection process for Para Legal Volunteer posts involves an assessment based on the application submitted and a subsequent interview. Candidates should prepare accordingly.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for DLSA Prakasam Para Legal Volunteer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply offline by downloading the application form from the official website https://prakasam.dcourts.gov.in/, filling it, attaching required documents, and sending it to the specified address before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for DLSA Prakasam Para Legal Volunteer posts?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for the Para Legal Volunteer recruitment. Candidates can apply without any fee payment.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the job location for DLSA Prakasam Para Legal Volunteer?
faq.answer: The job location for Para Legal Volunteer posts is Ongole, in the state of Andhra Pradesh, under the District Legal Services Authority Prakasam.

faq.question: Q8. What is the official website for DLSA Prakasam?
faq.answer: The official website for District Legal Services Authority Prakasam is https://prakasam.dcourts.gov.in/. All official notifications and application forms are available there.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for Para Legal Volunteer posts?
faq.answer: The Para Legal Volunteer posts under DLSA Prakasam are on a Contract basis. Candidates should be aware of the contractual nature of the engagement.
